description: This header file defines the interface IAVBufferHelper for buffer handling, including methods for mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, secure writing, and copying buffer data. It declares a factory function for obtaining an instance of this helper.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for buffer management functions such as mapping, unmapping, size queries, writing secure data, and copying buffers.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a handle and returns a pointer to the memory, also sets the size of the mapped data.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps the memory from a handle, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory allocated for a specific handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer identified by the handle; has a default implementation that returns false.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data from one secure buffer to another using a specified mapping; defaults to false.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
